'''Kara Shuba''' was a failed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who survived the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Surviving by hiding in the shadows of the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]], Shuba cultivated a personality as an annoying and insane old woman to divert attention from herself. Shuba traded information for food with [[Drew Lokii]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leader in the [[City/Legends|city]] and head of the [[Freeport Security Force]].<ref name="Game" />
